dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Did you know, last night I received another message from that guy. He keeps thả thính me constantly, but I don't know if he's serious or just joking.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Thả thính? What did he say to you? And... do you like him?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: He complimented my chess skills, then said he wanted to take me for cà phê to "learn from my experience." I'm not sure if I like him, but I feel... a bit tò mò.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Hmm, sounds like he genuinely wants to get to know you. If you're tò mò, just go have cà phê with him once and see. Nothing to lose, right?

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Do you really think so? I thought you would... Never mind. Maybe I should go. But if he keeps thả thính without making any real move, it would be annoying.
